title: One Fungus Erased 97% Of A Bat Species
hook: A cave fungus erased 97% of one bat species.
closing: Losing bats removes free pest control, leaving farms and food prices exposed.
question: Have you seen fewer bats?

segments.say: White-nose syndrome reached 35 states. A fungus that began in one cave became a continent-wide threat.
Northern long-eared bats fell 97%. A once-common species nearly vanished within years.
Bat pest control can be worth $53 billion yearly. Their collapse sends that hidden bill toward farmers.
